title: TimeSkeleton core definitions
description: The definitions shared by the TimeSkeleton 0.7.0 timeline, group and bundle documents: numbers following the BOPP core primitives (a fraction is a [numerator, denominator] pair of integers with a strictly positive denominator, an integer is a JSON integer and a float is a JSON number), coordinates that name their unit and number type, the time units and number types of an axis, the id rule, the file metadata, and the graphical block's vocabulary (named styles, statements, selectors, element types, paints and declarations). This document validates no file by itself; the other documents refer to its definitions.

Fraction.description: Rational number encoded as numerator and non-zero denominator

prefixItems.description: Denominator. Strictly positive to prevent zero-division and negative bases.
Denominator. Strictly positive to prevent zero-division and negative bases.
Denominator. Strictly positive to prevent zero-division and negative bases.

Number.description: A bare JSON number or an exact Fraction pair.

NumberNonnegative.description: A non-negative bare JSON number or a non-negative exact Fraction pair.

NumberPositive.description: A strictly positive bare JSON number or a strictly positive exact Fraction pair.

TimeUnit.description: The unit of a timeline axis.

NumberType.description: The number type of every coordinate on a timeline axis. It selects the representation of a coordinate's value: int is a JSON integer, float a JSON number, fraction a Fraction pair.

Coordinate.description: A position on a timeline axis: the axis unit, the number type, and the value in the representation that number type selects.

value.description: The position, represented as selected by number_type.

CoordinateNonnegative.description: A coordinate that cannot lie before the origin of its axis, such as a timeline length.

value.description: The non-negative position, represented as selected by number_type.

Id.description: An identifier: a non-empty string without '/' and without control characters (U+0000 to U+001F); spaces are allowed. An id identifies; a name, where an element has one, is what is displayed.

schema_version.description: The timeskeleton release this file conforms to.

generator.description: Free-form identification of the software that wrote the file.

Graphical.description: How the manifest is drawn (`docs/drawing.md`): named styles and an ordered list of statements. A statement selects drawn elements and sets presentation properties on them, either directly or by naming a style of `styles`; a name that `styles` does not hold sets nothing. Writers never reorder the statements. An absent block draws every element with the other style layers alone.

statements.description: Statements in order; of two statements of equal rank the later one decides.

Statement.description: One statement: the elements it selects and the properties it sets on them, as a declaration or as the name of a style.

oneOf.description: The name of a style of the same block's `styles`.

Selector.description: An element matches when it matches every member present. The empty selector matches every element.

ids.description: Element addresses; the element's address must be one of them.

domain.description: The domain of the element: what its time measures (graphical space, musical time, physical time).

modality.description: Whether the element is continuous or discrete.

class.description: The class of the element: its timeline's class, or a conversion map's type.

within.description: A timeline id: the element must belong to that timeline or to one of its descendants.

inside.description: An element type: the element must be held, at any depth, by an element of that type in the drawing's element tree.

ElementType.description: The type of a drawn element: the box's background, the root timeline's line (in a group or bundle file, a member's line or an ungrouped root's line), a child timeline's line at any depth, a conversion map, a region, a flow-control break or jump, a wedge at the root's start or end, a name in the name column (or the title of a group or bundle), any other text label, a segment's boundary tick on its segment line, an ancestor line of a member that is a child timeline, a group's frame, or the raised card holding a timeline drawn in its own card.

Paint.description: A colour as #RRGGBB with upper-case hexadecimal digits, or none.

Declaration.description: Presentation properties named as in SVG. An element reads only the properties its type reads; the others are ignored.

stroke-dasharray.description: none, or non-negative decimal numbers separated by single spaces.
